title: Aureline M5 sealed-archive manifest
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a sealed collaboration-evidence archive produced when a session ends. Describes the retained archive by content-addressed, policy-labeled identity instead of generic "session recording saved" language: the retention mode it was captured under (live-only, metadata audit, replayable text / comment timeline, or elevated support / regulatory evidence), the content address that pins the exact bytes, the policy label bounding export and delete rights, the archive outcome (disclosed awaiting consent, consent renewal required, guest scope widened, export / delete-right disclosed, sealed archive created, or blocked with no consent), and the audit-safe attribution of who created or changed it so a retention change, external guest, or archive creation stays attributable. Raw session bodies, raw command text, raw variable bodies, and raw clipboard contents never cross this boundary — only metadata about the archive does.
